Here it looks plausible, but slight irregularity in the blur transition near the plate edges warrants a low-severity flag for verification.

The texture of the left scone appears slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth in the mid-tones compared to the crispier crust of the right scone. The crumb structure lacks fine detail, potentially indicating generative smoothing.
